reviewed_by: Claude Code, fixing the operator-reported repeated lifecycle hook rows in the chat area
reason: Defect: a turn's Lifecycle hooks list showed one bare row per hook run (a tool.before hook on a 9-tool turn gave 9 identical lines), centered by the one-line status-pill class .chat-action-status, with the hook name and 'tool before' run together. Root cause (validated by a separate subagent and by reading SessionsPage.tsx): the list maps every NativeHookExecution 1:1 since per-tool-call hooks (12589f9), its container reused .chat-action-status (flex, centered, green 11px), and <strong>/<small> were adjacent inline elements. Fix: a HookOutcomes component groups clean runs (complete/reconciled, no error or reconciliation detail) by hook, event, status and side effects into one row with a count; failed, timed-out, interrupted, running and reconciled-with-detail runs keep their own rows with their error and late outcome. Events read 'Before tool'/'After tool'. The container gets its own left-aligned .chat-hook-outcomes list styling with wrapping rows and a gap between name and detail. The summary text is unchanged. Selected: HookOutcomes.test.tsx (labels, grouping, rendering), guides.test.tsx (the hook-outcomes guide anchor is kept), and Playwright area chat-tools-paths (desktop, compact, mobile-webkit-small), whose mocked lifecycle-hooks test now returns three runs and checks the grouped row, left alignment, the name/detail gap and Axe.
exclusions: Real-Core LAN: provider-native-hooks-core (real-core.spec.ts 'provider selections survive reload and restart reconciliation') showed 'Lifecycle hooks · 2/2 completed' on load, reload and after hook removal with this change, then failed at line 3693 (pending-turn poll for restart reconciliation); the same test fails at the same line on origin/main, so the area is not selected. App.test.tsx 'refreshes operator revisions after activation' timed out once under host load ~9 and passes alone with and without this change; App.test.tsx is not selected. No Core, setting or catalog change.
